description: Use when testing Wi-Fi security on authorized engagements with written permission covering the wireless network. Covers putting adapters into monitor mode, surveying access points and clients with airodump-ng, capturing WPA and WPA2 four-way handshakes with targeted deauthentication, cracking captures with aircrack-ng and hashcat, and the clientless PMKID attack. Use when the scope names an SSID or office wireless, or when you need to prove a weak pre-shared key before a wired test begins.
